column1: # Hand labels for iteration 12 of the engineering-role loop (issue #10).
# They label the 1000 rows sampled by iteration 11 in docs/measurements/engineering-role-2026-10-01.md.
# Labelled on 2026-09-23 from docs/engineering-role-criterion.md alone, at revision
# 1154f3a10cf095505fbfdf41e011db7aa00294ec, over the bare cleaned titles, before any rule of the
# classifier was read.
# Labelled by a subagent denied the classifier's source, the iteration reports and the earlier
# label fixtures; it read the criterion and the sample and nothing else.
# This fixture is never regenerated: a session is not reproducible, so the labels are the artifact
# and not the process that made them.
# Families labelled under criterion rules a future revision might supersede:

# - Product roles: (Product Manager Patient Growth, Staff Product Manager Wallet Authentication, Product Design Lead, Product Specialist, Director Product Management): all UNKNOWN domain_ambiguity per the product rule, even when a software-ish qualifier (Onchain, Search, Wallet Authentication) is present; product-marketing / product-development-with-market titles (Director Product Marketing, Director Product Development Edibles) went OUT through the market marker.

# - Managers/leads/directors over software qualifiers: (Engineering Manager Platform, Manager Platform Engineering, IT Project Manager, Director AI Data Science Marketing Measurement, Salesforce GTM Systems Manager): IN, treating manager as engineering-capable when the qualifier names software work. Bare or non-software Engineering Manager (Manager Engineering, Engineering Manager Credit and Lending) and Technical Program / Technical Account / Technical Delivery Manager: scope_ambiguity (phrase splits software vs manufacturing).

# - Sales/solutions/customer engineers and solution consultants: (Pre Sales Engineer, Enterprise Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer Auth0, Customer Engineer Vietnam, Solution Consultant): scope_ambiguity. Solution/solutions architects without a software qualifier (Solution Architect Financial Services, Delivery Solutions Architect Digital Native Business) went domain_ambiguity; with one (AI Solutions Architect, Data Solution Architect, Microsoft Copilot Pre Sales Solutions Architect) IN.

# - AI-training gig posts:: IN when the named role is software (HTML CSS Developers AI Training, Javascript Developers AI Training, Database Administrator Graduates AI Training); OUT when it names a non-software expertise or a plain trainer/participant (Mechanical Engineering Experts PhD AI Training, Khmer Language Specialist AI Trainer, Canada Residents AI Trainers, Survey Participants).

# - Vendor-package roles: (Salesforce Administrator, Bilingual SAP EWM Consultant, Five9 Telephony Admin, Business Analyst OpenLink, Oracle EBS O2C SME, ERP Analyst 1): IN, reading the vendor package as a software qualifier; HR Systems Manager (no named package) went OUT under the generic-head rule.

# - Split engineer phrases with no software qualifier: (Quality Engineer, Reliability Engineer, Test Engineer, Knowledge Engineer, Autonomy Engineer, Finance Systems Engineer): scope_ambiguity; while engineers with an unclassed market modifier (Mission Engineer, Project Engineer, Engineer iGaming, Design Engineer) went OUT by step 6, and bare/rank-only engineers (Staff Engineer, Engineer Team Lead) domain_ambiguity.

# - Data/business analysts: (Data Analyst MedTech, Business Analyst Insurance Domain, BI Analyst RTB, Analytics Lead Data Measurement Impact): scope_ambiguity; other domain-free analysts with market markers (Treasury Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst, Media analyst) domain_ambiguity; analysts with a credential marker (Actuarial Analyst, Language Data Analyst Croatian) OUT.

# - Designers and technical-art/pipeline roles: (UX UI Designer, Game Designer, Instructional Designer vs 2K Games Technical Art, Experienced Pipeline TD): designers read as never-engineering (OUT); technical art / pipeline TD scope_ambiguity since they often script.

# SUPERSEDED BY THE CRITERION REVISION OF 2026-09-24. The rows are never rewritten, but the
# families below were labelled before the criterion decided them, so a session pricing a
# candidate rule against the accumulated labels treats them as evidence-free rather than as
# costs:
#   - Managers: a manager over a technology noun (IT, Data, Security, Salesforce Manager) is now
#     scope_ambiguity, and a bare Engineering Manager, with or without a market marker, is now
#     domain_ambiguity.
#   - Technical Product Manager and Technical Program Manager are now IN; Technical Project
#     Manager is now domain_ambiguity.
#   - AI-training posts: the expertise named decides, and a post that names none is now
#     scope_ambiguity.
#   - Named enterprise packages (SAP, Salesforce, Oracle EBS, NetSuite, Workday) under consultant,
#     analyst or administrator are now scope_ambiguity.
#   - Reasons only, not states: a product title with no software qualifier is now
#     scope_ambiguity, and the two corpus reasons were redefined as "the domain is unclear" and
#     "the expertise is unclear".
